t: This is the London Oratory, a Catholic community of priests living by the rule of life set down by Philip Neri. The Oratory House stands next to the Church of the Immaculate Heart of Mary on Brompton Road, in Kensington and Chelsea. Father Thomas Francis Knox died here in 1882. He was an Ulster-Scots Catholic priest and author, known for his historical writings and translations, and he is remembered as an archivist as well.
